title: A box lists the running background commands and stops one
body:
coax has no view of the background commands it has recorded. The only way to find one today is `ps`, which is how Jack found go-grip a day and a half after its session ended.

## Proposal

- A box, opened like the history box, lists every live entry in the state file. Each row shows the command, its age, its folder, and whether this coax's session started it.
- A key on a row stops that command's process group, first with `SIGTERM` and then with `SIGKILL` if it stays up. coax then drops the entry.
- The status line shows the number of running background commands when it is above zero.

## Open

- Which key or `/` command opens the box.
- Whether the box can stop a command that another coax session started.
